source_note: M49 is a statistical classification of countries or areas. It explicitly does not imply political affiliation, sovereignty, or boundary delimitation. Do not treat M49 codes as a sovereignty classification.

fields.name: display name
fields.m49: UN M49 numeric code where assigned

coverage.note: This is the registry schema and seed for countries already represented in the Atlas. Expand from the complete UN M49 country-or-area list, then supplement with carefully sourced disputed and partially recognised entities. Never infer legal status from inclusion.
